title: 语言的消亡与守护
text: 当一种语言彻底消失，我们究竟失去了什么？这不仅仅是沟通工具的缺失，更是整套认知体系的崩塌。在全球化浪潮中，少数语种正面临前所未有的生存危机。许多原住民文化随着长辈的离世而逐渐沉寂。年轻一代倾向于学习通用语，以获取更多就业机会。这种趋势导致了文化多样性的锐减。语言承载着独特的历史记忆与民族情感。某些特有的词汇无法被精准翻译，因为它们根植于特定的自然环境。如果失去了母语，后代将难以理解祖先的智慧。数字化时代为抢救濒危语言提供了新契机。通过录音与数据库，学者们能够记录下珍贵的口语资料。然而，单纯的存档并非真正的保护。真正的传承需要让语言在实际生活中流动。政府应当制定合理的政策，支持双语教育。社区应当鼓励年长者向孩子传授传统方言。多样性是人类文明最宝贵的财富。我们不能任由这些声音在沉默中消散。守护语言即是守护人类精神的广度。只有尊重每一种表达方式，世界才具有真正的包容力。这需要社会各界的共同努力。让每种声音都能被听见，才是文明进步的标志。

questions.prompt: According to the text, losing a language means losing more than a communication tool — what else collapses?
options: Only the regional economy
An entire cognitive/knowledge system
Nothing of real significance
Only tourism revenue

questions.prompt: According to the text, why can certain unique vocabulary not be precisely translated into other languages?
options: Because translators deliberately refuse to translate it
Because it is rooted in a specific natural environment
Because it is kept secret by native speakers
Because it has no real meaning at all

questions.prompt: According to the text, why is simple archiving (recordings, databases) not considered true protection of a language?
options: Because databases are prohibitively expensive to maintain
Because true inheritance requires the language to keep flowing in actual daily life
Because archiving is technically impossible today
Because it violates international copyright law

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does it suggest communities should encourage elders to do?
options: Stop speaking their native language in public
Pass down traditional dialects to children
Focus exclusively on written records
Avoid teaching children the language entirely

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is identified as humanity's most precious wealth?
options: Financial capital
Advanced technology
Military strength
Diversity

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.
